rules.detail:
Tech's must complete videos on 85% of all CP and Warranty RO's to achieve the bonus. 
Internal RO's are NOT included in this bonus program. This includes any recalls and/or warranty work completed on new or used vehicles. The warranty hours associated with new or used vehicles will not be paid out. 
PDI's are NOT included in bonus program. 
Videos must be at least a 15 second duration.
The bonus is a MTD program and is paid out the first week of the following month. 

Video inspections are a great tool for us to build trust with the customers through transparency. The goal of the MPVI video is to showcase the services we are recommending and give the customer a visual of why. We can tell the customer they have a leak, with a video we can show them. 

When completing videos, every car and every customers needs are different. With that, there are a few items that should be in every video. 

Tech introduction (i.e. their name, store name). Expectation is the tech makes this their own. 
A brief walk around of the vehicle to confirm with the customer that it is in fact their car. 
Showcase any recommended work (I.E. Filters, Tires, Bulbs, Leaks, ECT.) 
Any work that would not be represented well visually with a brief explanation such as time or mileage recommendations. 

The focus is to create videos that your advisor team is confident in when recommending work to customers. This is a great tool for them to utilize to close the sale.
